name: fitgutlab
description: FitScope — skeletal muscle mitochondrial oxidative capacity from NIRS arterial-occlusion data, for Claude Code.

plugins.name: fitscope
plugins.description: Runs and audits the NIRS mitochondrial oxidative capacity pipeline (clean → analyse → plot) end to end: cleans a raw Artinis Oxysoft export, computes mVO2 per occlusion with Ryan et al. 2012's blood-volume correction, fits the monoexponential recovery time constant Tc, and reports QC/plausibility flags. Follows Ryan et al. 2012 (J Appl Physiol) and Ryan et al. 2014 (J Physiol).
